name: closkell
description: Syntax highlighting, formatting, and linting support for Closkell.

closkell.executablePath.description: Path to the closkell executable. When empty, the extension tries target/debug, target/release, cargo run -p cli, then PATH.

closkell.cargoCommand.description: Cargo executable used when the extension runs the workspace compiler with cargo run -p cli.

closkell.commandTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for Closkell formatter and checker commands.

closkell.format.enable.description: Enable Closkell document formatting through closkell fmt.

closkell.lint.enable.description: Enable Closkell diagnostics through closkell check --json.

closkell.lint.onChange.description: Run Closkell diagnostics after edits with a short debounce.

closkell.lint.onSave.description: Run Closkell diagnostics when a Closkell document is saved.
